title: Medical Debt, Inflation and Your Bills: What to Know
description:
Michael Bordenaro argues that medical debt exposes a deeper squeeze on household budgets. This recap puts his collections claim in context: medical debt represented 36% of third-party collection tradelines in Q1 2023, versus 57% in 2022. We cover his examples of insured patients refusing payment, his suggestions for discounts, itemized bills and financial assistance, and his warnings about lawsuits and garnishment. Then we examine his arguments about inflation, both political parties and higher Treasury yields affecting housing, stocks and company finances. His outlook is commentary, not verified current news.

For entertainment and informational purposes only. This is not financial, legal, medical, or other professional advice. Consult a qualified professional about your circumstances. We are not responsible for decisions or results based on this video.
